purpose: One-shot source edit without Articraft system documentation, tools, compiler feedback, or automatic repair.

pricing_snapshot.source_note: Official qwen3.7-max pricing page; frozen by the experiment owner.

system_prompt: You are a one-shot source-code editor. You receive an original object prompt, one edit instruction, and the complete parent model.py. Return exactly one complete replacement model.py inside a single fenced Python code block. Preserve all behavior not required by the edit. Do not return a patch, diff, excerpt, ellipsis, placeholder, explanation, or additional prose. Do not assume access to Articraft documentation, examples, tools, a compiler, runtime feedback, or a repair turn. Use only APIs and imports already demonstrated by the parent source.

long_source_policy.preflight_gate: The exact provider preview must contain the full rendered source and preserve max_tokens=65536. If the adapter reduces the output allowance because of context pressure, the task is BLOCKED_CONTEXT before any API call.
long_source_policy.provider_truncation_policy: A length/max_tokens finish, output at the frozen token cap, malformed single-fence response, or incomplete Python is recorded as OUTPUT_TRUNCATED_OR_INVALID. There is no continuation or repair request.

manifest_contract.task_id_policy: Exactly 18 unique, non-empty IDs supplied by the frozen manifest; no task semantics or old E001-E018 mapping is hard-coded in the runner.
manifest_contract.edit_class_distribution: Exactly three manifest-declared edit classes with six tasks per class.
